content.title: Immunization Services, History and Records | Walgreens
content.text: More than one vaccination, more peace of mind. Flu, COVID-19, RSV, pneumococcal—these are just some of the vaccines our pharmacists can help you stay up-to-date on. Whether you need one or a few, we’ll walk you through your options and make it easy to get what you need, when you need it. Vaccines take about 2 weeks to become fully effective, so don’t wait. Schedule now your immunizations for peace of mind Vaccinations made simple, for every stage of life. Your life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and your vaccines shouldn’t be either. Whether you’re 25 or 75, planning a trip or cuddling a newborn, our pharmacists can help you stay protected with the vaccinations that fit your life. Not sure what you need? We'll help you understand which vaccines are recommended for your age, health, and lifestyle. All adults should get an annual flu shot and stay up-to-date with their Tdap vaccine. Depending on your age and health status, additional recommended vaccines may include: Shingles 50+RSV 75+, 50–74 at increased risk of severe RSV, or pregnantPneumococcal 50+ or 19–49 with certain risk conditions And if you’re 65+, many vaccines may even be available at no cost with insurance or Medicare.* Schedule now your immunizations for every stage of life*No cost to you with most insurance or with Medicare Part B & D coverage. Check with your plan for coverage and copayment rules. Stay protected with these vaccines. Click on a vaccine below to get more information. COVID-19Helps reduce the risk of severe illness, hospitalization, and death from COVID-19.Influenza (flu)Offers protection against the flu and the more serious complications it can cause.Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)Has been shown to be effective in preventing respiratory disease caused by RSV. Pneumococcal (pneumonia)Lowers your risk of pneumococcal infections.Shingles (herpes zoster)The most effective way to protect against shingles and related complications from the disease.COVID-19Helps reduce the risk of severe illness, hospitalization, and death from COVID-19.Influenza (flu)Offers protection against the flu and the more serious complications it can cause.Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)Has been shown to be effective in preventing respiratory disease caused by RSV. Pneumococcal (pneumonia)Lowers your risk of pneumococcal infections.Shingles (herpes zoster)The most effective way to protect against shingles and related complications from the disease. Not feeling your best? You’re in the right place. Our pharmacists are here to help when you need it most. They can offer flu and COVID-19 testing, treatment,** and recommend over-the-counter relief products depending on the results. **Treatment available in following states: AR, CO, FL, ID, KS, KY, MI, MN, NE, UT, WA, and WI. Our pharmacists know a lot about vaccines. See what they have to say about what’s right for you and how to stay protected. Looking for more resources? Vaccines subject to availability.
